jobs.name: rotate_crb
jobs.command: [ -f data/crb.bin ] || exit 0; last=$(ls data/crb.[0-9]*.bin 2>/dev/null | awk -F'.' '{print $(NF-1)}' | sort -n | tail -1); next=$(printf '%06d' $((${last:-0} + 1))); mv data/crb.bin "data/crb.${next}.bin" && echo "rotated to crb.${next}.bin"

jobs.name: rotate_source_crb
jobs.command: [ -f data/source_crb.bin ] || exit 0; last=$(ls data/source_crb.[0-9]*.bin 2>/dev/null | awk -F'.' '{print $(NF-1)}' | sort -n | tail -1); next=$(printf '%06d' $((${last:-0} + 1))); mv data/source_crb.bin "data/source_crb.${next}.bin" && echo "rotated to source_crb.${next}.bin"

jobs.name: archive_logs
jobs.command: for f in log/server.log log/mcp-client.log; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; rm -f "${f}.7"; for i in 6 5 4 3 2 1; do j=$((i+1)); [ -f "${f}.${i}" ] && mv "${f}.${i}" "${f}.${j}"; done; cp "$f" "${f}.1"; truncate -s 0 "$f"; echo "rotated $f"; done
